# Acronyms And Terms

## Operational acronyms

- RPO: recovery point objective
- RTO: recovery time objective
- PITR: point-in-time recovery
- DLQ: dead-letter queue
- CSP: content security policy

## Product terms

- time balance: accumulated difference between expected and worked hours
- export queue: background pipeline that renders accounting files
- weekday map: schedule values for Monday through Sunday
